model_annotations.Bulgarian: Графиката илюстрира сравнение на стойности за "Per-Output" и "Per-Layer" в зависимост от "Sparsity Rate". Хоризонталната ос представя "Sparsity Rate" и е надписана с тази етикета, като категориите са подредени във възходящ ред: 10%, 20%, 30%, 40%, 50%, 60%, 70% и 80%. Вертикалната ос е надписана с "Perplexity" и използва логаритмична скала, с диапазон от 1 до 1000, с отметки на интервали от 10 (1, 10, 100, 1000). Има два набора от стълбове, всеки представящ една от двете категории: "Per-Output" и "Per-Layer". Стълбовете за "Per-Output" са оцветени в синьо, докато стълбовете за "Per-Layer" са оцветени в оранжево. Най-късият стълб за "Per-Output" е приблизително 1, докато най-високият е около 80. Стълбовете за "Per-Layer" варират от приблизително 2 до около 950. Стълбовете са подредени в съответствие с "Sparsity Rate" и няма визуално подчертани стълбове.
model_annotations.Chinese: 这张条形图展示了在不同稀疏率下，Per-Output和Per-Layer两种指标的值。横轴表示稀疏率，标签为“Sparsity Rate”，从10%到80%不等，以10%为间隔排列。纵轴表示指标值，标签为“Perplexity”，采用对数刻度，范围从10¹到10³，刻度标签间隔为10的整数次方。图中有两组条形，分别代表Per-Output和Per-Layer。Per-Output条形为蓝色，Per-Layer条形为橙色。从左到右，Per-Output条形的高度依次约为1.2, 1.5, 1.8, 2.1, 2.4, 2.7, 3.0，在80%稀疏率时最高，约为3.0。Per-Layer条形的高度依次约为1.3, 1.6, 1.9, 2.2, 2.5, 2.8, 3.1，在80%稀疏率时最高，约为3.1。条形按照稀疏率从小到大的顺序排列，图中没有条形被特别强调。
model_annotations.English: This bar chart illustrates the relationship between sparsity rate and perplexity for two different configurations, Per-Output and Per-Layer. The horizontal axis, labeled "Sparsity Rate," displays categories ranging from 10% to 80% in 10% increments. The vertical axis, labeled "Perplexity," is on a logarithmic scale with a base of 10, ranging from 10⁰ (approximately 1) to 10² (approximately 100), with tick labels at 10⁰, 10¹, and 10². Two sets of bars are presented, one in blue representing "Per-Output" and the other in orange representing "Per-Layer." The bars are arranged side-by-side for each sparsity rate category, allowing for visual comparison between the two configurations. The shortest blue bar, corresponding to a sparsity rate of 10%, has an approximate value of 1.5, while the tallest blue bar, at 80% sparsity, has an approximate value of 70. The shortest orange bar, at 10% sparsity, has an approximate value of 2, and the tallest orange bar, at 80% sparsity, has an approximate value of 90. The bars are sorted in ascending order based on the sparsity rate, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their color differentiation.
model_annotations.German: Das Diagramm veranschaulicht die Perplexität für verschiedene Sparsity-Raten, aufgeteilt in zwei Kategorien: "Per-Output" und "Per-Layer". Die horizontale Achse, beschriftet mit "Sparsity Rate", zeigt die Sparsity-Raten in Schritten von 10% bis 80%, also 10%, 20%, 30%, 40%, 50%, 60%, 70% und 80%. Die vertikale Achse, beschriftet mit "Perplexity", verwendet eine logarithmische Skala mit dem Basis 10 und reicht von 10¹ bis 10³. Die Tick-Marken sind in regelmäßigen Abständen von 10¹ bis 10³ angeordnet. Zwei Barreihen sind dargestellt: "Per-Output" in Blau und "Per-Layer" in Orange. Die "Per-Output"-Balken haben Werte von ungefähr 1,2 bei 10% Sparsity bis etwa 75 bei 80% Sparsity. Die "Per-Layer"-Balken haben Werte von ungefähr 1,5 bei 10% Sparsity bis etwa 90 bei 80% Sparsity. Die Balken sind in aufsteigender Reihenfolge der Sparsity-Rate angeordnet. Keine der Balken ist visuell hervorgehoben.
